sources.title: Annual report / financial results
sources.supports: FY2025 core earnings C$7.5bn; core is non-GAAP

financial_anchor.caveat: FY2025 core earnings are a non-GAAP, after-tax-style performance measure; reported shareholder net income is separate.

ai_claim.claim: Manulife describes scoped AI/digital mechanisms in underwriting and claims triage at matched risk and fairness, service/document automation with human review.
ai_claim.stage: E1; E2 only where management explicitly reports production use
ai_claim.scope: vintage loss/claims outcome at fixed mix, expense per resolved case, lapse rate and risk-adjusted new-business value
ai_claim.limitation: No controlled quality-adjusted company result tied to retained incremental cash was found.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Sun Life and digital insurers and wealth platforms using third-party models can replicate tools or force gains through to customers.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Competitive capability does not by itself prove equal outcomes.

rights_limit: Policyholders and counterparties originate much data; consent, insurance secrecy and geography limit purpose and reuse. Public privacy terms do not establish pooled model-training rights.
materiality_summary: Five percent of the completed-year governing metric is C$375m; public evidence does not establish an AI-attributed amount.

arithmetic.inputs: FY2025 core earnings C$7.5bn; 5%; illustrative eligible expense C$2.5bn, efficiency 10%, realization 60%, retention 50%, recurring cost C$40m; illustrative tax rate 20%
arithmetic.formula: C$7.5bn × 5% = C$375m hurdle; C$2.5bn × 10% × 60% × 50% − C$40m = C$35m illustrative benefit; C$35m × (1 − 20%) = C$28m after tax
arithmetic.result: Illustrative C$28m after tax is below the C$375m annual after-tax hurdle. The 20% tax rate is an explicit research assumption, not company guidance.

g2_provisional: Open: E1/E2 evidence supports measurement, but E3 quality-adjusted causality and E4 cash retention are not established.
unresolved_questions: What share of eligible workload is in production?
What controlled quality-adjusted KPI result exists?
What do contracts permit for pooled learning and how much benefit is retained after recurring cost?
